Our client is going through a large-scale IT transformation. They're looking for an experienced Solution Architect who loves both the big picture and the technical detail, and who wants real impact in a technology leadership role.

• Team up. You'll work hand in hand with business owners, domain architects and engineers to deliver high-quality results

• Shape the roadmap. You'll define target architectures and roadmaps for a core business domain, using your hands-on experience

• Build for reuse. You'll create solution patterns and building blocks that other teams can rely on

• Share what you know. You'll lead communities of practice, exchange lessons learned with fellow architects and help the architecture practice grow

• 10+ years in IT, with solid experience as a Solution Architect on large transformation programmes

• Strong architecture skills: event-driven and service-based architectures, MicroServices, RESTful APIs

• Agile and DevOps experience at scale, including CI/CD. SAFe knowledge is a nice bonus

• A Togaf certification, or a similar one

• Tech you've worked with: .NET, Angular, Azure, Kafka, SQL, BPM/low-code platforms, Mainframe backends and SaaS packages

• The ability to zoom in and out: you're as comfortable writing a strategy document as solving an implementation challenge

• A pragmatic mindset: you go for what works, not what looks perfect on paper

• Autonomy and sharp analytical skills: you break down complex problems across teams and locations and come up with actionable answers

• Strong communication skills: you can convince project teams and senior management alike

• A mentor's spirit: you enjoy helping newer architects grow

• Fluent English

 

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services and its regulatory environment

• Knowledge of capital markets

• Familiarity with frameworks like Open Agile Architecture

Are you someone with a passion for data who doesn't just process numbers, but critically examines them? Then you might fit right into this team.

• Financial Reporting: Prepare accurate and timely financial reports for management.
• Financial Controlling: Review and validate the figures provided by the Finance team to guarantee data integrity.
• Variance Analysis: Conduct in-depth variance analyses, explain deviations, and identify emerging trends.
• Budgeting & Forecasting Support: Gather and structure data to support the budgeting and forecasting processes.
• Process Review & Optimization: Review existing processes and keep an eye out for efficiency gains and contributeideas to improve our internal financial processes.

• Bachelor’s degree in a financial or economic field, or equivalent experience.
• Min 2-3 years of hands-on experience as a Controller/Financial Auditor. Experience in an international environment is a plus.
• Excellent command of English (spoken and written). Knowledge of Dutch is a plus.
• Strong analytical acumen, a critical mindset and an uncompromising attention to detail.
• Solid, demonstrable experience in financial reporting and variance analyses. Advanced knowledge of MS Excel is required. Experience with NetSuite and/or Salesforce is considered a strong asset.

jobs.occupation: Order picker in day shift - open to English speakers!
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you already need to live in Belgium for this job, preferably in the region of Oostkamp or Bruges. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium you do not qualify !!

You've gained your first experience in accounting administration. Now you're looking for more variety, more responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Our client, part of an international high-tech group, is building its Belgian operations in Zaventem. With a growing team of around 30 colleagues, we're looking for a hands-on Administration & Accounting Officer who enjoys working with figures, keeping things organised and making things happen.

You'll be the local go-to person for administration and accounting, reporting to the accounting team at the group’s headquarters and working directly with the Plant Manager.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do?

No two days will be quite the same. You’ll combine day-to-day accounting administration with administrative support to the Plant Manager and the monthly payroll coordination.

Accounting administration

• Encode accounting documents in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: supplier invoices, credit notes, purchase orders and expense reports. 
• Match invoices with orders and deliveries, and follow up on discrepancies with suppliers and colleagues.
• Follow up on open items and payments.
• Prepare the information the HQ accounting team needs for the monthly closing and answer their questions.
• Keep the accounting files complete, well organised and audit-ready.
Administration – Support to the Plant Manager

• Provide administrative support to the Plant Manager: 
• Keep the local administration up to date and help improve administrative processes as the team grows.
Payroll 

Coordinate the monthly payroll with Acerta: collect and send the variable data, follow up on questions and check payslips before validation.

• Encode payroll-related documents such as contract changes, absences, leave and overtime.
• Record payroll data in Dynamics 365 for the HQ accounting team.
You won’t be expected to know every system from day one. Your precision, organisational skills and willingness to learn are what matter most

What do you bring?

• A Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in accounting or a related field.
• 2 to 3 years of experience in accounting administration, ideally combined with payroll support.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or a similar ERP.
• Experience with Acerta or another Belgian social secretariat is an asset.
• Excellent English, essential for communication with the HQ accounting team.
• French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.
• A precise, organised and independent approach.
Above all, you're someone who takes initiative, enjoys helping colleagues and feels comfortable in a small, fast-moving team.
